major_findings.title: SLSA L3 scorecard cites workflow paths not verified in PR diff
major_findings.evidence: specs/microservices/scorecards/canonical/slsa-l3.json declares overall_status=green but the cited .github/workflows/slsa.yml / cosign.yml / sbom.yml / release-musl.yml workflow files were not part of the inspected PR diff window.
major_findings.recommendation: Add a SLSA L3 scorecard-grounding test (oya-check-slsa-l3-evidence-grounded) that fails CI if any evidence_pattern in slsa-l3.json points at a non-existent file. Currently grounding is paper-only.

major_findings.title: T2-auto Cedar refusal not lane-asserted
major_findings.evidence: tasks/T2-auto.yaml + network/recruiter capability + forms/AI-form-build all claim 'REFUSED at Cedar layer for pack-eu employment context pending ADR-TASKS-XXXX conformity'. The refusal is the EU AI Act Annex III §4 mitigation, but no CI lane in this PR demonstrates 'oya gate validate eu-ai-act-employment-context-refusal' running against the actual Cedar fragments and confirming Action::auto_assign in employment-context is structurally denied.
major_findings.recommendation: Add an integration test that exercises a synthetic AnonymousMember principal + Action::auto_assign + employment-context resource against tasks/policy/tenant-scope.cedar and asserts Cedar verdict = Deny. Without this lane, the refusal is a documentation claim, not an enforced control.

minor_findings.title: 5 Cedar fragments don't reference cedar-canonical-imports.cedar
minor_findings.evidence: 150 of 155 .cedar files have the canonical-imports comment header (SWEEP-I Slice 1 per ADR-0064). 5 domain-specific fragments (dual-context-isolation.cedar, legal-process-disclosure.cedar, providers-openbao-credential.cedar, personal-dm-scope.cedar, affinity-attestation-verification.md) declare their own complete envelopes.
minor_findings.recommendation: Add explicit 'no canonical-imports needed: stand-alone envelope per [reason]' comment to those 5 to make CI grep-based assertions explicit. Currently distinguishable only by manual review.

minor_findings.title: OWASP ASVS L3 not explicitly claimed
minor_findings.evidence: PR body and threat models cite 'OWASP ASVS v4' but level claimed is implicitly L2; L3 is not declared even for E2E-bearing µservices (notes/messenger/anonymous) where it would be appropriate.
minor_findings.recommendation: Per-µservice scorecard for personal-tier µservices should declare ASVS L3 + cite specific L3 controls (V2.1.5 multi-factor, V6.4.2 key management, V9.2.3 mutual-TLS, V14.1.5 supply-chain).

minor_findings.title: Helm canonical-helper indirection reduces grep-readability
minor_findings.evidence: 10 of 32 deployment.yaml templates show no inline runAsNonRoot/readOnlyRootFilesystem — they delegate to 'oya.securityContext.podStandard65534'. This is correct per SWEEP-J Slice 2, but a future Kyverno/OPA admission-check scanning rendered manifests post-helm-template is the only confirmation the canonical helper actually produces the restricted profile.
minor_findings.recommendation: Add a CI lane that runs `helm template microservices/<ms>/iac/helm/<chart>` and pipes into `kyverno apply policies/restricted-pod-security.yaml` to assert the produced YAML carries the restricted controls. Convention-only enforcement is fragile.

minor_findings.title: OCI env-var pattern for ClickHouse S3 disk could improve
minor_findings.evidence: workflow-engine/clickhouse/values.yaml uses `<access_key_id from_env="OCI_ACCESS_KEY"/>` + `<secret_access_key from_env="OCI_SECRET_KEY"/>`. Env-vars are presumably populated from OpenBao at pod-init, but the chain isn't documented in the values.yaml itself.
minor_findings.recommendation: Add a comment in the values.yaml block: '# OCI_ACCESS_KEY / OCI_SECRET_KEY env-vars populated from openbao:secret/workflow-engine/clickhouse/oci-s3 via init container per ADR-0043.' Make the OpenBao chain explicit at the point of use.

summary.overall_posture: Strong defense-in-depth. Cedar v4.2 LTS default-deny + per-pillar FORBID; OpenBao SecretReference discipline holds across 253 references with 0 raw-secret detections; pod-security restricted profile applied (inline + canonical-helper); NetworkPolicy default-deny + tight egress allowlists; gVisor sandboxing covers all untrusted-input workers (Whisper/Pandoc/LibreOffice/ffmpeg/blind-sig crypto); audit-chain seals on critical state changes; SLSA L3 scorecard green on paper.
summary.recommendation: approve-with-comments: ship as-is. The 2 major findings are gap-grounding lanes (SLSA evidence grounding + EU AI Act Annex III refusal lane assertion) that strengthen what the PR already claims — they do not block. The 4 minor findings improve auditor-readability without changing posture.
